body.statement: For every \(S\subseteq E\), \[h_{\mu}(S)=\max_{A\subseteq X}\{\mu_1(A)-\mu_0(N_{S^{\mathsf c}}(A))\}=\max\!\left\{0,\max_{\substack{\varnothing\neq A,B\subseteq X\\A-B\subseteq S}}\bigl(\mu_1(A)+\mu_0(B)-1\bigr)\right\}.\] Both maxima and the minimum defining \(h_{\mu}(S)\) are attained, including when marginal cells are zero.
body.justification: The identity converts robust coverage into finite Hall certificates with the correct complement orientation.
body.gap: Koperberg2024 proves finite Strassen deficiency for a fixed relation; this specialization is supporting machinery and is not claimed as the headline novelty.
body.consumer: The all-minimizer theorem and the confidence epigraph use the displayed Hall deficiencies as their certificates.
